request_text_excerpt: Subject: CPRA 25-944 — Disputed Claim of Agreement, Consolidation Records, and Outstanding Hard-Copy Request To Samuel Harvey and the City of Berkeley: Your May 20, 2025 response to request 25-944 states: “As agreed upon between your attorney Tania Rose and the City,” followed by discussion of identifying responsive records and consolidating overlapping requests. I never approved or authorized combining my public records requests. Please identify precisely what agreement the City claims existed, its date, its participants, and its scope.
